## Summary

Describe the change and the user problem it solves.

## Scope

- [ ] Firmware
- [ ] Hardware or wiring
- [ ] Printed parts
- [ ] Documentation

## Validation

List the hardware, operating systems, applications, and test steps used.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no private data or generated build files.
- [ ] Documentation and the changelog were updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] Existing CAD mode and slicer mouse mode were checked when applicable.
